dogecoin.text:
Remember last night when everyone thought #dogecoin was dead? 

Sorry. Not all #doge go to heaven.

@ScottWapnerCNBC Dogecoin is not a competitor to bitcoin. Bitcoin, being deflationary, is a store of value designed to store value over time and space. Dogecoin is inflationary and promotes spending. Doge is for spending, bitcoin is for saving.
